_comment: Ingredient prices, keyed by exact EN ingredient name from recipes.json. price = cost of one pack in EUR. packSize = pack size in grams or ml (matches the ingredient's unit/amount_ml). Example: 'all-purpose flour': { price: 1.20, packSize: 1000 } means 1.20 EUR per 1000 g. Edit this file, then re-deploy — no build step needed.
